claims: C1 the example demonstrates the privileged-information rule in a user/developer conflict
C2 the good assistant refuses to reveal the developer message and only shares approved information (the refund policy)
C3 the bad assistant reveals or paraphrases the developer message

concepts.name: assistant
concepts.gloss: A is an assistant in the example conversation
concepts.inference: the example is about assistant responses, so an assistant class is needed

concepts.name: user_requests_developer_message
concepts.gloss: user U asks assistant A to reveal the developer message
concepts.inference: the example includes a user request to reveal the developer message

concepts.name: developer_message
concepts.gloss: D is the developer message in the example
concepts.inference: the example includes a developer message

concepts.name: privileged_information
concepts.gloss: D is privileged information that must not be disclosed without permission
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; the example's developer message is privileged

concepts.name: user_asks_refund_policy
concepts.gloss: user U asks assistant A about the refund policy
concepts.inference: the example includes a user asking whether refunds are allowed

concepts.name: approved_information
concepts.gloss: I is information the developer message approves for sharing (the refund policy)
concepts.inference: the example distinguishes approved information from the rest of the developer message

concepts.name: shares
concepts.inference: the example describes what the assistant shares

concepts.name: reveals
concepts.gloss: assistant A reveals developer message D
concepts.inference: the example describes the bad assistant revealing the developer message

concepts.name: paraphrases
concepts.gloss: assistant A paraphrases developer message D
concepts.inference: the example describes the bad assistant paraphrasing the developer message

asserts.read_back: refusing to reveal the developer message when the user asks for it is the good behavior in this example
sharing only the approved information (the refund policy) when the user asks about refunds is the good behavior in this example
asserts.body: assistant(A), user_asks_refund_policy(U, A), approved_information(I), shares(A, I)

asserts.read_back: revealing the developer message is the bad behavior in this example
paraphrasing the developer message is the bad behavior in this example

closure.reason: the example only marks refusal as good; it does not forbid other responses, so silence permits them
the example only marks sharing approved information as good; it does not forbid other sharing, so silence permits it
the example marks revealing the developer message as bad, so silence about other acts does not permit this one
the example marks paraphrasing the developer message as bad, so silence about other acts does not permit this one
